correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact two-site four-state stationary law with covariance (1-a-b-r)/T², which has at most one zero for all a,b>0. In the three-site (a,b)=(1,1/10) generator, independent eight-state exact balance calculations reproduce the positive-denominator stationary polynomials and downstream covariance -20Q(r)/D(r)², where Q=30000r⁴+93500r³+6900r²-114345r+7497, D=200r³+4230r²+21471r+28455. Signs at r=0,1/4,1 are respectively negative,positive,negative. Descartes' two-sign-change upper bound proves exactly two simple strictly positive zeros. Continuity of finite irreducible stationary laws proves the stated open neighbourhood (at least two changes), not a general phase diagram.
